title: Regulation of other animals.
bodyText: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as a limitation on the authority of the counties to regulate, including by licensure, animals other than dogs.
bodyHtml: [§143-2.5]  Regulation of other animals.  Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as a limitation on the authority of the counties to regulate, including by licensure, animals other than dogs. [L 1988, c 270, §2]
